channel.title: Andalusia Star News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Andalusia Star News (andalusiastarnews.com)

item.title: Jail Report from February 13 to February 16
item.description: Covington County Jail report lists local arrests Feb. 13–16, including assault, probation violations, fleeing police, child endangerment and domestic violence charges, with bonds up to $260,000.

item.title: Andalusia Civitan Club presents funds to running programs
item.description: Andalusia Civitan Club donates Candyland Christmas Half Marathon and 5K proceeds to Andalusia and Covington County school running programs.

item.title: Triumph over Bulldogs and Bears takes Florala to Regionals
item.description: Florala boys topple Kinston and Leroy to claim area title and a 21-4 mark, earning a regional berth in Montgomery and a Sweet 16 showdown with Brantley.

item.title: Remembering our Veterans: Charlie F. Walker, Sgt. U.S. Army, 1st Infantry Division, Vietnam
item.description: Sgt. Charlie F. Walker, a Vietnam radio operator with the 1st Infantry Division, recalls being wounded in combat, earning a Purple Heart with two Oak Leaf Clusters, and building a life in Alabama.

item.title: OCC to host Bingo night Feb. 19
item.description: Mardi Gras-themed Bingo night comes to Opp Chamber of Commerce Feb. 19 at 6 p.m., with $5 entry, $1 cards, cash prizes, and local door prizes at 104 W. Covington Ave.

item.title: Garner to run for BOE Place 5
item.description: Lifelong Covington County resident and bank CEO Micah Garner announces Republican bid for Covington County Board of Education Place 5, stressing his financial background and countywide perspective.

item.title: Back-to-school tax holiday set for July 17 to 19
item.description: Covington County sets 2026 back-to-school tax holiday, fills board seats, advances building project, and prepares for new road graders at Feb. 10 commission meeting.

item.title: SE Gas’ Veasey retires after 47 years
item.description: After 47 years with Southeast Gas, longtime Leak Survey Technician Kelly Veasey retires, leaving a legacy of pipeline safety across nearly 1,400 miles of mains and 20,000 service lines.

item.title: Straughn High School’s Bennet signs with FSC
item.description: Straughn High senior Kyleigh Bennett signs to play softball at Florida State College at Jacksonville after returning from shoulder surgery and hopes to one day teach and coach at SHS.

item.title: HENDERSON IS ELITE
item.description: Covington County native Zakia Henderson, a 15-year pageant veteran with 86 titles and 2,000 service hours, shares her year as NAM Alabama Elite Queen and her next goal in Atlanta.
